overview: 针对四足机器人运动控制中的全身协调问题，本文提出了一种结合强化学习与基于模型的全身控制（WBC）的分层框架。该方法利用强化学习调整结构化的运动参考（包括步态、触点等），而底层的步态调度器和脉冲控制器负责高频执行。作者声称，通过在干扰课程环境下进行训练，该分层控制器在模拟器中的平均存活率优于单纯的基准模型控制器。

highlights.text: 提出了一种将强化学习与基于模型的全身控制相结合的分层架构，通过调整结构化运动参考实现自适应运动。
highlights.evidence: We present a hierarchical controller in which reinforcement learning adapts these structured locomotion references while a gait scheduler, reactive footstep planner, and whole-body impulse controller retain responsibility for high-frequency execution.

highlights.text: 实验结果显示，该分层控制器在六方向干扰测试下的平均存活率为77.29%，显著高于对照组的50.35%。
highlights.evidence: Under a common simulator and evaluation protocol, the proposed controller achieves 77.29% mean survival across the tested disturbance grid, compared with 50.35% for the model-based reference controller.

highlights.text: 消融实验表明，自适应落脚点规划是对提升抗干扰性能贡献最大的因素。
highlights.evidence: Training-time channel ablations identify adaptive foothold placement as the largest marginal contributor to grid survival and reveal direction-dependent effects of gait-rate adaptation.
